name: Righteous Avengers
description: Pick a visible friendly fighter within 6" of this fighter that has not activated yet this battle round. You can activate that fighter immediately after this fighter’s activation ends. That fighter adds 1 to the strength characteristics of any attack actions it makes until the end of its activation.

name: Cleaving Blow
description: Until the end of this fighter's activation, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee attack actions made by this fighter that target an enemy fighter with a Wounds characteristic of 15 or more.

name: Thunderstruck
description: Until the end of the battle round, enemy fighters within 3'' of this fighter cannot make reactions.

name: Overwhelming Volleystorm
description: Until the end of this fighter's activation, if a ranged attack action made by this fighter scores any hits or critical hits, subtract 1 from the target fighter's Toughness characteristic (to a minimum of 1) until the end of the battle round.

name: Impaling Strikes
description: Until the end of this fighter's activation, the next time this fighter finishes a move action within 1" of an enemy fighter, pick a visible enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter. Allocate a number of damage points to that fighter equal to the value of this ability.

name: Atavistic Tempest
description: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 6" of this fighter. Allocate a number of damage points equal to the value of this ability to all enemy fighters within 3" of that fighter.

name: Living Weapon
description: A fighter can make this reaction after they are targeted by a melee attack action but before the hit rolls are made. For each hit roll from that attack action that misses, allocate 1 damage point to the attacking fighter. This reaction cannot be made by fighters with the Beast runemark.

name: Dracoth Riders
description: Friendly fighters with the mounted runemark may make climb actions.

name: Furious Retribution
description: Pick a visible friendly fighter within 6" of this fighter that has not activated yet this battle round. You can activate that fighter immediately after this fighter’s activation ends. That fighter adds 1 to the strength characteristics of any attack actions it makes until the end of its activation.

name: Lightning Storm
description: Pick a point on the battlefield within 12" of this fighter and roll a number of dice equal to the value of this ability. For each roll of 4+, allocate 1 damage point to all enemy fighters within 4” of the selected point.
